load_hermes_dotenv: load Hermes .env files from user home and project directories with precedence rules
sanitize_loaded_credentials: strip non-ASCII characters from credential env vars ending with _API_KEY, _TOKEN, _SECRET, or _KEY
load_dotenv_with_fallback: load a .env file with UTF-8 encoding and fall back to Latin-1 on decode errors
sanitize_env_file_if_needed: pre-sanitize a .env file by splitting concatenated KEY=VALUE lines before dotenv parses it
test_load_hermes_dotenv: test load_hermes_dotenv with custom hermes_home and project_env paths
